==Transportation==
*The fastest way there is using a charged [[Amulet of glory|amulet of glory]] to teleport to [[Draynor Village]] and running east (~33 ticks)
*Teleporting to [[Twiggy O'Korn]] with an [[Achievement diary cape]] and running east (~37 ticks)
*Using [[Lumbridge Teleport]] and running west through the castle, exiting through the gate, and running north-west (~41 ticks)
